title: Existing solar collectors on adjoining sites coded R40 or less keep 4 hours of sun on 21 June
text: Where adjoining sites are coded R40 or less, buildings are oriented to maintain 4 hours per day solar access on 21 June for existing solar collectors on neighbouring sites.
notes: Applies where an adjoining site coded R40 or less has existing solar collectors (adjoining.solar_collectors_r40_or_lower, proposed). overshadow.solar_collectors_affected read as: the development reduces direct sun to any such collector below 4 hours on 21 June. Not limited to climate zones 4 to 6.
